comment: Deliberate exceptions to MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2. Every entry needs a written reason. The order module reaches the account module in-process by default; only a deliberate split deployment opts into HTTP, and that adapter fails at startup when its token is missing.

allow.reason: Opt-in split deployment only: SDKWORK_ORDER_ACCOUNT_LEDGER_ADAPTER=http selects this adapter; the default is the in-process store adapter, and from_env() refuses to start without SDKWORK_ACCESS_TOKEN.
